headline: TT&A, CMS INDUSLAW advise investors on Nua $50 million Series C fundraise
sum: Lagom Labs Private Limited, dba Nua, has raised $50 million from a Series C fundraise co-led by Peak XV Partners and Filter Capital India. TT&A advised Peak XV Partners Growth Investments IV on this fundraise.
detail: Lagom Labs Private Limited, dba Nua, has raised $50 million from a Series C fundraise co-led by Peak XV Partners and Filter Capital India. TT&A advised Peak XV Partners Growth Investments IV on this fundraise. The transaction team consisted of Sachin Mehta (Partner), Nikhil Bahl (Partner), Garvita Mehrotra (Managing Associate), Associates Dakshita Arora and Eshani Agarwal, and Ruchi Tripathi (Company Secretary). Sachin Mehta, Nikhil Bahl CMS INDUSLAW advised Filter Capital India on this fundraise.
